summary.zh: 解决饥饿时，口渴和疲劳还在继续累积。
summary.en: While fixing hunger, thirst and fatigue keep building.

rules.zh: 玩家查看多个持续变化的需求，挑选当前最值得处理的一项。采集、吃饭、休息都要花时间；补上一条状态时，其他状态可能恶化，因此目标是维持可行动的余量。
rules.en: Read several changing needs and decide which deserves attention now. Gathering, eating and resting all take time; helping one need can let another worsen, so preserve enough capacity to keep acting.

loop.en: Spend time to restore one need

decisions.zh: 先补最少的一条，还是先处理下降最快的一条？剩余量和恶化速度都要看。
decisions.en: Fix the lowest meter or the fastest falling one? Both level and rate matter.

decisions.zh: 绕路拿更多食物，还是趁精力足够先回营地？
decisions.en: Detour for more food or return while enough energy remains?

effect.zh: 不同速度使优先级不断变化；完全同速容易变成固定轮流补满。
effect.en: Different rates change priorities; identical rates encourage a fixed refill routine.

effect.zh: 先降低行动效率、再扣生命，能给玩家一次调整计划的机会。
effect.en: Losing efficiency before health gives players a chance to change plans.

contrast.zh: 漫漫长夜围绕身体补给安排日程；饥荒额外让理智参与决策，同样的食物路线会遇到不同压力。
contrast.en: The Long Dark schedules physical needs; Don’t Starve adds sanity, changing the pressures around a food route.

combination.zh: 设计提案：资源复访路线按饥饿、疲劳和日落时间重新排序，让今天的最优路线不同于昨天。
combination.en: Design proposal: reorder renewable foraging routes around hunger, fatigue and sunset so today’s best route differs from yesterday’s.

setup.zh: 演示设定：饥饿还够两轮，疲劳只够一轮。
setup.en: Example: food lasts two turns; energy lasts one.

action.zh: 先在营地休息一轮，放弃立即采果。
action.en: Rest at camp for one turn instead of picking fruit.

result.zh: 精力恢复，但食物只够下一轮。
result.en: Energy returns, but food now lasts only one turn.

next.zh: 下一轮必须找食物，不能继续休息。
next.en: The next turn must secure food rather than more rest.

firstStep.zh: 先做两个需求条、采集和休息两个按钮，每次操作推进一轮。
firstStep.en: Start with two need meters and Gather/Rest buttons; each action advances one turn.

pitfall.zh: 需求过多会把判断变成检查仪表；先让两项形成清楚冲突。
pitfall.en: Too many meters turn decisions into dashboard checking; start with two clear conflicts.

test.zh: 交换两个需求的下降速度，看玩家是否主动改变行动顺序。
test.en: Swap the drain rates and observe whether players change action order.
